Configuration of users of the ECU State Manager
Short Description
Type:
--
Importance:
High
Description:
Users, indicating the operational needs of individual software components,
shall be pre compile time configurable attributes of the ECU State Manager.
Requests from unknown sources are ignored.
Rationale:
All users are known and configured at compile-time.
This requirement supports static administration of (known) state requestors
on the ECU; it supports also testing and documentation.
Use Case:
--
Requesting and releasing states.

--

--

4.1.3.1.2.1 [BSW09227] Configuration of privileged users
BSW09227
ID:
WP Functional Safety
Initiator:
11.07.2008
Date:
Configuration of privileged users
Short Description
High
Importance:
It shall be possible to configure a list of privileged users per protected
service. Protected services (by sense of this configuration issue) are:
-
EcuM_SelectShutdownTarget
Description:
The configuration shall be possible at link time.
To support defensive behavior of BSW modules it is necessary to declare
the authorized users of a service at system generation time.
Rationale:
-
A not allowed access to one of the protected services will be rejected
without execution of the requested service.
Use Case:
-
An allowed user requests the execution of a protected service.
